title: Contemporary Condo in Central Location, Sleeps 5
description:
Modern fifth-floor condo less than two miles from downtown with a rooftop lounge, gym, fast WiFi, and full kitchen. Sleeps five with one queen bed, two twin beds, and a sofa bed.

The space
Stay less than two miles from downtown Nashville in this bright, modern fifth-floor condo. The open-concept home includes a full kitchen with stainless-steel appliances, a comfortable living area with smart TV, high-speed WiFi, room-darkening shades, central air conditioning, and a private workspace.

The condo sleeps up to five guests:
• Bedroom: one queen bed
• Common area: two twin beds
• Living area: one sofa bed

Shared building amenities include a rooftop lounge, fitness center, cornhole court, elevator, and on-site laundry room. Streaming services are available with guests’ own accounts. The Drip Bar next door is an official Bounce luggage-drop location.

Guest access
As our guest, you'll have full access to the entire property, except for a few areas reserved for house supplies.

Other things to note
| ▼ Important |

☑︎ A shared laundry room is available on-site. 
☑︎ The Drip Bar, located next door, is now an official Bounce luggage drop location for guest convenience.

| ▼ Things to Know |

☑︎ Check-in time: 4:00 PM
☑︎ Check-out time: 10:00 AM
☑︎ Quiet Hours: 10:00 PM - 8:00 AM
☑︎ All guests shall abide good neighbor policy and shall not engage in illegal activity.
☑︎ NO smoking is permitted anywhere on the premises.
☑︎ Streaming services available with guests’ own account(s)
